China provided satellite imagery to Iran for strikes on US bases, reports say

Reports indicate that China provided satellite imagery to Iran, which Iran then used to target US bases. Fox News cited a report linking Chinese imagery to Iran's strikes on US bases. The Jerusalem Post also reported that Chinese sources gave satellite imagery to Iran for strikes on US bases. Former President Donald Trump commented on the matter, stating that China 'spies' on the US.
